descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Penthouse Basketball 2 puts you at the top of a tower at golden hour, in a penthouse with a full-height glass wall on every side.

Upstairs is somewhere to live: an open kitchen and dining room, a living space under a lit ceiling raft, a bedroom and a bathroom, panelled walls and warm oak floors, with the city burning orange and pink through the glass.

Downstairs is where you play. A sunken hardwood basketball court runs out through the wall into a barrel-vaulted glass dome cantilevered over the city, so you shoot with nothing but glass between you and a 330 metre drop. There is a full bowling lane, a giant dartboard, ring toss and cornhole, a rack of twelve balls, and a balcony you can walk out onto.

SHOOTING THAT ACTUALLY FEELS RIGHT
Grab a ball and swing. It releases by itself at the top of your motion, the way a real shot leaves your hand. No timing a trigger, no fighting the physics. The ball is a real size 7 with a real bounce, and every basket counts on the board above the backboard.

WHAT'S IN IT
- A sunken hardwood court inside a glass dome over the skyline
- Auto-release shooting, twelve basketballs, live scoring
- A full bowling lane with automatic ball return and a RESET PINS button
- Darts, ring toss and cornhole, all scored
- A furnished two-floor penthouse to explore
- A balcony with a table of things you can drop over the rail
- A Miami-sunset city with air traffic and a skyline that runs to the horizon

Runs at a locked 72 fps.
